prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Columbus. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Which Columbus do you mean (Columbus, OH; Columbus, GA; Columbus, IN; another)? Also, do you want UV beds (sunbed/tanning booth), spray tanning (airbrush/automated), or are you open to either?

If you want, I can immediately pull a short list of nearby salons (with phone numbers, addresses and quick reasons to call). Before that, here are the most useful questions to ask every salon when you call so you can compare options:

- Do you offer spray tans, UV beds, or both? Which brands/types do you use? (e.g., high-pressure/low-UV beds, stand-up or lay-down, automated vs. technician-applied spray)
- Do you do a skin-type consultation or patch test for first-timers?
- What are your first-time or single-visit prices and any membership/package options?
- Are your technicians certified and what training do they have for spray tanning?
- How do you sanitize spray booths and tanning beds between clients?
- What lotions/solutions do you use (organic, DHA percentage, bronzers)? Can I bring my own?
- Do you have age limits or require parental consent for minors?
- What are your hours and typical availability for same-day appointments?
- Any current specials for first-time customers?
- Do you recommend any pre- or post-tan care or products?
- What precautions do you give for sunbed tanning (skin cancer risk, eye protection)?

Tell me which Columbus and which tanning method you prefer and I’ll list specific salons to call with short reasons why each is worth contacting.
